cost_interpretation: Batch wall includes OpenMP scheduling, query setup, search, and post-search scoring. Probe/score sums are thread-seconds, not wall time. Whole-process wall including final manifest comes from external stage_run.
exact_GT_cost_reason: Previously computed GT reused; original computation cost is not reconstructed
index_checksum_verification: Inherited full P0 SHA256; this program verified bound path, current bytes and loaded shape, without a repeated full index hash
mask_layout: little-endian uint16, candidate-major, query-contiguous; bits follow saved GT10 order and are restricted to target leaf
